## About
Our chiropractic office on Ridgeview Drive in Allen serves Allen, McKinney, Plano and Frisco. We treat athletes from the weekend warrior to the pros, moms and kids, and everybody in between, whether you slept wrong or have been slouching at your desk.
Dr. Matt Moreno is a Certified Chiropractic Sports Practitioner and one of the few practitioners in the nation qualified to support the PGA Tour. Dr. Evan Secord is Webster certified and dedicates her practice to families, from pregnancy to life with little ones. Dr. Luc Gradisar has treated children, professional athletes and Olympians. Each earned their doctorate at Parker University.
Brandi Todd, our office manager, was one of our very first patients. She will be the voice you hear when you call and the face you see first when visiting us. We are rated 5 from 216 Google reviews.

## Services
- Athletic care: Care for athletes from the weekend warrior to professionals, aimed at improving athletic performance and reducing risk of injury.
- Prenatal, postnatal and pediatric care: Dr. Evan helps moms through every stage of pregnancy and cares for little ones too.
- Back pain, headaches and TMJ: Treatment for low back pain, headaches, TMJ dysfunction, golf mobility and other musculoskeletal complaints.
- Therapeutic massage: EJ Johnson works with patients using therapeutic massage alongside corrective exercise.

## FAQ
Q: Can I talk to a doctor before booking?
A: Yes. Fill out the form to set up a free phone call with one of our doctors and ask whatever questions you have about your issue.

Q: Will I be treated at a discovery session?
A: No. A discovery session is for you to ask questions about your problem and for us to confirm whether we can help.

Q: Who can help me with paperwork and insurance questions?
A: Brandi Todd, our office manager. She will get you scheduled, take care of your paperwork, explain your insurance and show you around.
